sources.quote: We want to be transparent with our community. As a team of only two devs, generative AI tools were used only during early prototyping to accelerate game design iteration and research for the game. Any AI generated assets from the prototype have been fully replaced with original artist made content in the final game. No AI generated content is present in the game, everything is human made.
